tests.test: ServiceSupervisor lifecycle accepts only a matching diagnostics-ready handshake
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle shares concurrent start calls and forks once
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle waits for an in-flight start before stopping and rejects new starts while stopping
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle waits for the shutdown response and owned child exit
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle rejects a forged shutdown success payload without treating it as an acknowledgement
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle rejects a malformed bundle report from the worker
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle rejects in-flight requests and reports a failed state after an unexpected exit
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle retains a timed-out child and ignores messages from its old instance after restart
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle preserves an acknowledged shutdown timeout through a retry and late exit, then starts a new instance
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle keeps the first control fault when an unacknowledged instance exits with code 0
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle keeps the first control fault when an unacknowledged instance exits with code 9
ServiceSupervisor lifecycle fails a handshake timeout without discarding ownership or replacing the child

provenance.method: Independent baseline checkout with only the new regression test file applied; expected 3 failures.
